title: Core Decet #20
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, ten women in a single row.

A photograph of TEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 10 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[jirai-kei / Heavy Muscle]: Japanese woman, early 50s, cool and composed, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, long black hair in twin tails tied with pink and black ribbons under a blunt fringe, a hollow, dreamy expression, braided hair, coffin nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground. Shoes: extreme ochre platform stiletto corset-lace boots.

A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Shoes: extreme bold silver platform stiletto pumps.

[Bollywood Glam / Polynesian Goddess]: Indian woman, mid 40s, sultry, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, twin-tail hair, oval nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. [Turkish Glam / Super Glamour]: Turkish woman, early 50s, cool and composed, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, braided hair, coffin nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 10, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
